Durable units that tank damage and deal consistent damage to enemies

Fishermen are suited for close to medium-range combats and are the main offence of the team. They generally possess the most destructive power in man-to-man fights and tend to use Reel or Needles as their primary weapon.
Long-range units designed to deal massive amounts of damage

Spear Bearers attack from long distance and snipe the opponent using Spears as their primary weapon. They do not tend to be very powerful in a melee, but are very valuable due to their pinpoint attacking from a distance.
Disruptive units that excel at applying debuffs, breaking synergy, and compromising the enemy backline

Scouts move ahead of the group, observe the environment and situation, and aid the Fishermen as secondary offence. They are usually lightly armed for the intention to be agile and swift in movement and thinking.
Strategic support units specializing in utility, buffs, and lighthouses
Lightbearers use Lighthouses to gain information on the battle or the surroundings. They gather information and formulate plans with the help of such information as they command their Lighthouse.
All rounder units that help their team by manipulating shinsu and providing shinsu-related buffs and debuffs

Wave Controllers help their allies in battle by attacking the enemy or aiding the team by manipulating Shinsu. This position is rare compared to the others and requires an expert and specialized manipulation of Shinsu.

Characters, creatures, and locations from Tower of God. Units are deployed to the battlefield, have HP and a shinsu cost to deploy, and occupy one or more of the positions printed on their card.

Equipments are attached to ally deployed units for enhancements. A unit can only hold 1 equipment at a time unless it is a Living Ignition Weapon.
